purpose: Define licensed/registered module publishers as explicit identities separate from package signer, repository, module identity and certification issuer.

topics.name: Module Publisher Identity
topics.purpose: Define licensed/registered module publishers as explicit identities separate from package signer, repository, module identity and certification issuer.

semantics.identity_rule: Each publisher has an explicit identity.
semantics.organization_rule: Publisher may map to exact organization IdentityCore identity.
semantics.repository_rule: Repository account/path is a binding only.
semantics.module_rule: Publishing a module does not transfer the module's semantic ownership unless the module contract says so.
semantics.license_rule: Publisher eligibility may depend on commercial/license policy.
semantics.certification_rule: Publisher status does not imply certification.
semantics.authority_rule: Publisher identity grants no runtime authority.

invariants.rule: Package, artifact, module, certification, license and installed-instance identities remain distinct; hashes prove content integrity only within their declared profile and never grant runtime authority.
License or certification entitlement permits declared product/service use only; it never substitutes for IAM identity, AccessCore authorization, runtime validation or dispatcher gating.

hard_gates.condition: repo username used as canonical publisher identity
publisher automatically owns every uploaded dependency
